report.subtitle: Generate a bilingual PDF of your financial overview, optional AI narrative, and schedule delivery to Telegram.
report.month_rule: Which month to include when the schedule runs
report.locale: Default language for PDF and AI text
report.sec_chart_monthly: Monthly income & spending trend (all loaded data)
report.sec_month_compare: Compare month to prior months / last year
report.sec_month_compare_help: Shown only in month-scoped PDFs. Enable at least one comparison: set prior months to 1–12, and/or turn on same month last year.
report.month_compare_prior_hint: 0 = none; 1–12 = that many calendar months before the report month.
report.month_compare_yoy: Include same calendar month last year
report.sec_month_compare_ai: AI narrative for month comparison (extra Gemini call)
report.sec_month_compare_ai_help: Uses the same months as the table above. Appears after the executive summary. Requires a configured Gemini API key.
report.investments_pdf_disabled_hint: Turn on investments under Configuration → Investments to include this section.
report.send_telegram: Send PDF to Telegram when the schedule runs
report.send_telegram_help: Sends the PDF to chats with “PDF report” enabled in Configuration → Telegram (not the same as scrape notifications). The Telegram bot must be running.
report.send_mqtt: Publish PDF to MQTT when the schedule runs
report.send_mqtt_help: Publishes a JSON payload with base64-encoded PDF to your configured MQTT notify topic. Requires MQTT enabled and connected in Configuration → MQTT.
